VIDEO SCRIPT: PARABLE OF THE MUSTARD SEED
Grade: Grade 4 · Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Parable of the mustard seed. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
• describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
• explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God
• appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
• Model 2: describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
• Model 3: explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God
• Model 4: appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
• Practise: describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
• Practise: explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Parable of the mustard seed.”
